text: The initiative aims to enhance financial preparedness and resilience to climate-related shocks in Fiji, focusing on low-income households, smallholder farmers, fishers, and micro/small enterprises. It is part of the Pacific Insurance and Climate Adaptation Programme (PICAP) and involves developing a national Climate Disaster Risk Financing framework and parametric micro-insurance products to provide rapid post-disaster liquidity.

metadata.solution_name: Developing Climate Disaster Risk Financing Framework and Parametric Insurance in Fiji (Pilot)
